title.original: Agent Identity URI Scheme: Topology-Independent Naming and Capability-Based Discovery for Multi-Agent Systems
title.zh: 智能体身份 URI 方案：多智能体系统的拓扑无关命名与基于能力的发现
title.en: Agent Identity URI Scheme: Topology-Independent Naming and Capability-Based Discovery for Multi-Agent Systems

inclusion_reason.zh: agent:// 的稳定命名、能力 DHT 和 PASETO 证明可复用于迁移、扩缩容和联邦环境中的 Agent 发现。
inclusion_reason.en: The agent:// stable naming scheme, capability DHT, and PASETO attestation are reusable for agent discovery under migration, scaling, and federation.

abstract.zh: agent:// URI 以信任根、能力层级路径和可排序唯一 ID 解耦 Agent 身份与网络位置，并支持 DHT 能力发现和 PASETO 证明。
abstract.en: The agent:// URI decouples agent identity from network location through a trust root, hierarchical capability path, and sortable unique ID, with DHT discovery and PASETO attestation.

problem.zh: 把 Agent 身份绑定 URL/主机会在迁移、扩缩容和跨组织联邦时打断引用、审计链和发现，迫使系统依赖中心协调。
problem.en: Binding identity to host URLs breaks references, audit trails, and discovery under migration, scaling, and federation, forcing centralized coordination.

approach.zh: 方案把组织权威、语义能力和稳定实例标识分离，按能力路径派生 DHT 查询，并用签名 token 将能力声明绑定身份。
approach.en: The scheme separates organizational authority, semantic capability, and stable instance identity, derives DHT queries from capability paths, and signs capability claims.

system_design.zh: 解析器处理 agent:// 三段式名称，DHT 索引按信任域发布能力，验证器检查 PASETO 证明后返回可联系端点。
system_design.en: A resolver parses three-part agent:// names, a trust-scoped DHT indexes capabilities, and a verifier checks PASETO attestations before returning contact endpoints.

key_results.zh: 在生产工具能力映射和大规模合成 Agent 上，方案实现无冲突表达、精确发现、迁移不变性和微秒级本地操作。
key_results.en: Across production-tool mappings and a large synthetic population, the scheme shows collision-free expressiveness, precise discovery, migration invariance, and microsecond local operations.

limitations.zh: 评测主要是合成发现与本地性能，尚未覆盖恶意 DHT、能力撤销、信任根治理、隐私泄露和跨域名称冲突。
limitations.en: Evaluation is mostly synthetic discovery and local performance, leaving malicious DHT behavior, revocation, trust-root governance, privacy leakage, and federation conflicts open.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 字段和数值仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格级条件、硬件与集群配置及更多对照项仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation fields and numbers above are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; table-level conditions, hardware and cluster configurations, and additional comparisons not stated there await full-text audit.
